description: Live joint state, user-jogged 2026-09-27, defining a NEW plan-initial source-magnet position for the vessel plan. SUPERSEDES the 2026-09-24 reference (which derived its exclusion radius from a tip-path-projected distance). This one uses the magnet-to-BEAM-BASE distance directly as the exclusion radius: the source magnet must never come closer to the beam base than it is at this position.
